title: P113 Wan2.2 and HunyuanVideo 1.5 calibration pilot

cases.title: Global-public animal movement baseline
cases.prompt: A documentary-style medium tracking shot of one clearly identifiable animal moving naturally through its habitat, stable anatomy, coherent direction, restrained cinematic camera motion and no visible text.
cases.negative_prompt: duplicate animal, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, flicker, warping, abrupt background changes, text, logo, watermark

cases.title: Territory-limited natural scene transition
cases.prompt: A controlled cinematic transition from a close animal detail to a wider habitat reveal, preserving subject identity, lighting direction and environmental continuity.
cases.negative_prompt: identity change, morphing subject, malformed anatomy, jump cut, flicker, text, logo, watermark

items.title: Product motion and controlled camera movement

cases.title: Global-public product orbit
cases.prompt: A clean premium product shot with a slow controlled camera orbit, stable proportions, consistent material finish, soft studio lighting and an uncluttered background.
cases.negative_prompt: shape deformation, changing labels, warped edges, floating parts, text hallucination, logo mutation, flicker

cases.title: Territory-limited simple background motion
cases.prompt: A locked product composition with subtle background light movement, gentle atmospheric particles and no change to product shape, markings or position.
cases.negative_prompt: product movement, label changes, camera shake, heavy particles, flicker, text, logo mutation

items.title: Map, diagram and cinematic hero integration

cases.title: Global-public map and diagram motion
cases.prompt: A precise cinematic camera move across an illustrated historical map, stable borders and symbols, subtle depth, no invented labels and no changing geography.
cases.negative_prompt: changing borders, unreadable text, invented labels, warped map, flicker, excessive depth distortion, watermark

cases.title: Territory-limited cinematic hero reveal
cases.prompt: A restrained cinematic reveal of a historically inspired environment at dawn, coherent architecture, controlled volumetric light, slow forward camera movement and a strong final composition.
cases.negative_prompt: architecture morphing, temporal inconsistency, aggressive camera shake, oversaturated glow, text, logo, watermark
